name: open-generative-ai
description: Open Generative AI is an uncensored, open-source AI image and video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters, no subscriptions, fully self-hosted. A self-hosted alternative to HiggsField.
short_desc: Uncensored open-source AI image & video studio — a HiggsField alternative
author: Mohammad Reza Rastgoo
